plan.encoding: canonical ASCII TSV with final LF
plan.partial_encrypted_sections: declared-skip, required in the PLAN only
plan.db2_entries: 1..=1161 exact canonical catalog name/FileDataID pairs, alphabetical names and unique IDs; exactly one Map is mandatory and every other canonical table is optional

package.manifest: forever-package.json with deterministic per-table partial-section declarations only
package.partial_encrypted_tables: For each selected DB2 table with TACT-declared available-source sections, including Map when partial, emit deterministic per-table declarations [{lookup, frame_ordinal, decoded_size}]. A complete table has no declaration. The table path binds each declaration to its containing DB2 entry.
package.partial_encrypted_sections: forbidden in the package manifest; the same-named PLAN gate remains mandatory
package.global_partial_encrypted_sections: forbidden; v25 global manifest declarations are not admitted
package.declaration_boundary: Only per-table partial_encrypted_tables declarations are admitted. Map follows the same rule as every other selected table; no global or package-wide partial-section declaration is permitted.
package.multi_frame_coverage: For every selected table, including Map, one or more E frames must exactly tile each ordered TACT-declared extent. Multiple frames per extent are admitted; crossing, missing, extra or inconsistent coverage rejects.

limits.partial_frames_scope: The total counts declarations across every selected table, including Map; the per-table ceiling is the existing CASC max_blte_frames limit.
limits.partial_frame_coverage: Multi-frame declarations must exactly tile every TACT-declared extent of every selected table, including Map.
limits.package_total_bytes_equation: 64 GiB terrain + 16 GiB DB2 = 80 GiB total

source_policy.db2: Only exact selected build-70450 catalog entries use the disabled-key available-source route. Each complete or declared-partial DB2 is bounded and checked against build-70450 WDC5 structural rules before publication. A selected entry that fails remains fatal and is not silently omitted.
source_policy.partial_sections: Only authenticated available-source encrypted frames whose decoded coverage exactly tiles the containing selected table's ordered TACT-declared extents may be zero-filled and declared per table. This applies equally to Map and all other selected tables. Bounded WDC5 framing and zero-fill checks are mandatory; no decryption or key material is admitted.
source_policy.map_terrain: Map additionally uses terrain_v20::authenticate_map/read_map_70450/materialize for independently derived terrain coverage v3. Materialized rows with a non-zero WDT FileDataID retain v20 source order; unknown TACT sections remain unknown and are not inferred from bytes.
source_policy.terrain_omissions: Only the v20 MissingFile-only WDT/root-ADT omission policy applies. Terrain conversion outcomes remain producer-reported.
source_policy.failure_policy: A selected table or terrain input that fails source authentication, WDC5 framing, zero-fill validation, exact extent coverage, Map projection authentication or a resource limit remains fatal.

verification.verify_scope: offline package integrity, intrinsic selected-DB2 WDC5/zero-fill and MAPS formats, exact per-table partial-section declarations including Map, and independently re-derived Map identity/order and terrain coverage v3
verification.verify_links_scope: the same checks; no navigation or external package links are part of v27

acceptance_matrix.expect: admit only Linux build 70450, wowdbdefs-70450-v1, component mask 9 (db2,maps), resident storage, disabled decryption, pack=true, unchanged pending flags and mandatory PLAN declared-skip
accept canonical esES plans with Map FDID 1349477 before SpellEffect FDID 1140088, terrain map:48 or all-available-maps, and exact render/parse roundtrip without client data
require exactly one canonical Map and reject zero or duplicate Map entries while admitting every other canonical catalog table
reject a missing or misdeclared PLAN partial_encrypted_sections field with product_plan_partial_encrypted_sections
reject provided-salsa20-v1, every component mask other than 9, navigation, map-domain, off-mesh, scratch, non-resident storage and changed pending flags before client/output work
accept 1 through 1161 selected canonical entries including exactly one Map; reject an empty selection and entry 1162
publish only per-table partial_encrypted_tables declarations, including Map when partial; global partial_encrypted_sections is forbidden in the manifest even though it remains required in the PLAN
for every selected table including Map, allow multiple E frames per TACT extent only with exact ordered coverage; reject crossing, missing, extra or inconsistent frames

accept at most 16 MiB per DB2 table, 16 GiB DB2 total, 65,536 frames per table and 18,576 frames total including Map; reject table 1162, frame 65,537 in one table or frame 18,577 overall; cap terrain at 64 GiB and the combined package at 80 GiB / 85,899,345,920 bytes

offline verification re-reads sealed Map through the v20 authenticate/read/materialize path and binds ordered selected Map IDs, WDT FileDataIDs, materialized rows, per-table declarations and compatible terrain coverage v3
synthetic-only fixtures exercise inspect, extract/resume, offline verify and verify-links for partial and complete selected tables, partial Map and terrain; no client data or decryption is used

the exact matching producer passes real build-70450 esES extract, offline verify and verify-links for the 1,161-entry catalog with map:48 and all-available-maps: 1,163 artifacts / 55,737,931 bytes and 4,555 / 271,392,871 bytes respectively; all DB2 and non-coverage terrain payloads match the separately accepted v26/v25 artifacts; no full-world or runtime claim
v25 authenticated partial-Map terrain and v26 DB2-only partial-catalog identities, grammars and contracts remain unchanged; their evidence does not transfer to v27

existing_evidence.v26: Existing v26-only real build-70450 esES evidence covers 1,161 selected DB2 artifacts: 1,055 complete and 106 declared partial. It does not include the v27 combined product or establish v27 acceptance by itself.
existing_evidence.v25: Existing v25-only real partial-Map plus terrain evidence covers map:48 and all-available-maps. It does not include the v27 partial catalog or establish v27 acceptance by itself.

legacy_preservation.v25_contract: forever-product-v25; Build70450AuthenticatedTerrainPartialMapV1; Db2|Terrain mask 9 and one Map
legacy_preservation.v26_contract: forever-product-v26; Build70450Db2PartialV1; Db2 mask 1 and 1..=1161 selected entries

excluded: decryption, key discovery or key use
complete DB2 content or whole-client DB2 coverage claims
